title: Not worth much
text: Not worth much. This product was hardly worth the dollar something I paid for it. It came broken and cracked. It is a cheap, thin plastic cup hardly bigger than a shot glass. Wouldn't recommend. . It seems easy enough to read. I haven't used it so cant attest to the accuracy of it's measurements but it surely wont last for long under normal use

product_metadata.title: Chef Craft Classic Plastic Shot Glass Measurer, 1 ounce teaspoon/tablespoon, Clear
features: Measures up to one ounce in teaspoons, ML and tablespoons
Can be used instead of a teaspoon in baking
description: Measuring is made easy with this mini measuring glass. It not only can be used to measure amounts for drinks, but also can replace a teaspoon, making it easier to carry your measurement from place to place. The plastic construction is very durable, so you don't need to worry about breaking it. This is the perfect shot glass/ measurer for the college student or home chef in your life. Dishwasher top rack safe for easy cleaning.
